public_rationale: The claim is a conditional forecast for calendar 2026. If OpenAI reaches about $30bn in revenue and keeps an adjusted operating margin of about -122%, its adjusted operating loss would be about $36.6bn (30 x 1.22). Scoring it requires full-year 2026 figures. The year ends after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date, and the contract has no early-resolution rule. The only dated evidence covers the second quarter of 2026 (April to June). An AI Weekly summary published 2026-08-18 cites WSJ reporting that Q2 revenue was about $6.7B and that the operating margin "sank further". It does not give a margin figure. This evidence does not show whether either condition holds for the full year. The claim cannot be scored yet.
limitations: No full-year 2026 revenue, margin or loss figures are available yet.
The Q2 2026 information comes from a secondary summary of WSJ reporting that cites unnamed people. It does not state the Q2 margin figure.
The evidence does not show whether OpenAI will reach about $30bn in 2026 revenue.
It is unclear whether 'maintains these margins' means every quarter or the full-year average.
